scope: Read-only static source review; reviewer ran no builds, tests, engines or timing. This review does not claim completion of the ongoing broad qualification or establish a performance result.
review: Eligibility requires an aggregate with closed SC_FIXED payload, no RegionOwner, and equal concrete representation/length contract at expression and destination. Profitability admits GLOBAL slots or statically limited inline-array destinations; local fixed-array and local record roots retain staging.

The literal-tree scan visits at most512 nonnull nodes per attempt and rejects unknown nodes, identifiers, references, SelfRef, casts, callbacks, dynamic capacities and nonliteral fill counts. Type/layout helper traversal is separate from that AST budget. No emission happens before a failed match returns.

Every nested default call must have exactly one natural result matching its checked contextual expression type. This rejects fixed-to-limited capacity adaptation inside an otherwise literal record before any direct outer write; fallback retains its Abort and prior global contents.

InitializeDecl calls the helper only for by-value FRAME/GLOBAL slots after owner handling. Other uses are fields of fresh aggregate construction. Ordinary ConstructInto and assignment snapshot order remain unchanged; nested pure fields can improve within the existing RHS temporary without publishing that RHS early.

AggregateLiteral, DefaultInto and StringInto retain full destination zero-fill, padding, array lengths, enum tags, declaration field order, fill-value evaluation once, and the existing per-element default loop/temporary scope. Exact destination types avoid removing runtime conversions.

Globals still initialize at every _start in original order. Admitted constructors have no observable call or fallible adaptation between their writes. Global static spans are in initial memory; frame spans remain covered by the existing reservation/check prologue. Less scratch storage may reduce resource demand; identical memory-exhaustion thresholds are not claimed.

CanonicalAddress is retained. Positive mappings originate only from separate FrameStruct result stages; current eligible globals/fresh fixed-frame destinations do not overlap those source ranges. Mapping receiving targets do not reverse-map. Text and globals have separate Data ranges, and frames start above data_end. Valid mappings/reentry therefore cannot alias StringInto destination with its static text source.

The broad all-fixed experiment is preserved separately with its measured regressions and static diagnosis. The final narrower policy contains no benchmark names, CPU-specific padding or engine-dependent behavior.
